plugins.name: dbml-translator
plugins.description: DBML schemas explained to non-developers, gap analysis against product specs, and Mermaid ERD rendering.

plugins.name: colonova-confluence-kit
plugins.description: Continuous maintenance and freshness management for the 8.8 ColoNova Confluence tree via an audit→refresh loop: colonova-folder-audit builds the refresh/execution queues and colonova-doc-router-publisher runs the updates from those page IDs. Covers routing, audit, freshness/staleness (living standards, 07 monitoring SLO/threshold pages, Approved design reviews, 09 living roadmaps), pending-supersession (05/08/12/ADR), incomplete-discussion-closure and new-subfolder-drift detection, single and batch refresh, supersession with inbound-link reconciliation, and approval-gated publishing skills.
